create_SupervisedPointPrediction: create a SupervisedPointPrediction task instance for training and evaluating point track prediction models
run_forward_fn: run the forward pass to predict point tracks from video inputs and query point coordinates
run_evaluate: run an evaluation epoch on a specified dataset mode to compute tracking metrics and occlusion accuracy
run_inference: run inference on a single video file to generate and save painted point track visualizations
run_pck_evaluate: run PCK evaluation on JHMDB pose estimation results across multiple keypoints and distance thresholds
